title: CIA-UAP-012, Combating Fatigue In Crewmembers
doc_notes: This document is a CIA Foreign Intelligence Information Report from 1976 regarding Soviet Aeroflot aerospace medical research and includes a brief, abstract discussion on UFO phenomena.

incidents.summary: Dr. Akoyev discussed UFO phenomena with an individual, noting that 99 percent of occurrences are traceable to natural or man-made phenomena, while one percent remains unexplained.
incidents.quote: 99 percent of these occurrences were traceable to either natural or man-made phenomena
